title: Short loops rescue late rings: every torus that reads distance plainly
claim: For tori of every shape of the square, triangular and honeycomb lattices of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12,12) contacts: (1) the systole lemma of PLAIN-TIME-20261108-001B holds for every covering of networks, in particular for the tube T/<v> of one lattice vector; (2) in the square tube of (2,1) and the triangular tube of (1,-1) every ring is on time with its closest contacts reached by an odd number of shortest routes (proved by a checked certificate, and by hand for the square tube; exactly one route in every case read), and every torus holding a rotation of (2,1) (index at least 4) or a vector of length sqrt 3 is on time; the two square tori of index 3 holding (2,1) or (-1,2) are late; (3) the mirror tube of (1,2) is late at distance 4; every other tube of a vector with fewer than 2 ell + m arcs to its translate is late within ell or joins a ring to itself; (4) hence a square torus is on time exactly when its lattice holds (2,0), (0,2), (2,1) or (-1,2) (index 3 excepted) or it is one of 23 listed tori of index 5 to 17; a triangular torus exactly when its lattice holds a vector of length sqrt 3 or it is one of 85 listed tori of index 4 to 21; a honeycomb torus exactly when it is one of 15 listed tori of index 1 to 9.
failure_conditions: A torus holding (2,1) or (-1,2) of index at least 4, or a triangular torus holding a vector of length sqrt 3, that is late.
An on-time torus that holds no family vector and is not listed.
A tube certificate condition failing at some contact.
A short non-family tube with no late ring within ell.
foundation_claim_scope: Tori of every shape of the square, triangular and honeycomb lattices of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12,12) contacts; two-time knots only (A30).

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's standing request on 2026-11-09.
validation.status: Theorem 1 by hand; Theorem 2 by hand (square tube) and by a checked certificate (triangular tube); Theorem 3 by Theorems 1 and 2 and an exact census to index 50, 93 and 48; stress test to index 100, 140 and 80
validation.novelty: new as far as found for the question asked: the complete list of tori of the three regular lattices that read distance across time plainly; short loops along which shortest routes are unique rescue them
